            end)
        end
    end)
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

local function startNoclip()
    if noclipConnection then noclipConnection:Disconnect() end

        if SETTINGS.ENABLE_NOCLIP and lp.Character then

                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function stopNoclip()
    noclipActive = false
    if noclipConnection then
        noclipConnection:Disconnect()
        noclipConnection = nil
    end

        for _, part in pairs(lp.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = true
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ========== FONCTIONS DE VOL ==========
local function cleanupFly()
    if flyThread then
        task.cancel(flyThread)
        flyThread = nil
    end
    if bodyVelocity then
        bodyVelocity:Destroy()
        bodyVelocity = nil
    end
    if bodyGyro then
        bodyGyro:Destroy()
        bodyGyro = nil
    end
    currentFlyCharacter = nil
end

local function startFly()
    local char = lp.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not hum then return end
    
    cleanupFly()
    
    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", root)
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    
    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro", root)
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    
    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming)
    
    flyEnabled = true
    currentFlyCharacter = char
    
    flyThread = task.spawn(function()
        while flyEnabled and char and char.Parent and root and root.Parent do
            local humCurrent = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if humCurrent then
                local moveDir = humCurrent.MoveDirection
                
                if bodyVelocity then
                    if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                        bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDir * flySpeed
                    else
                        bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    end
                end
                
                if bodyGyro then
                    bodyGyro.CFrame = cam.CFrame
                end
                
                if humCurrent and humCurrent:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
                    humCurrent:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming)
                end
            end
            task.wait()
        end
        cleanupFly()
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    flyEnabled = false
    cleanupFly()
    
    local char = lp.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
        end
    end
end

local function onCharacterAddedForFly(character)
    if SETTINGS.ENABLE_FLY then
        task.wait(0.5)
        startFly()
    end
end

local function onCharacterAddedForNoclip(character)
    if SETTINGS.ENABLE_NOCLIP then
        task.wait(0.5)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
end

lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    onCharacterAddedForFly(character)
    onCharacterAddedForNoclip(character)
end)

-- ========== FONCTIONS TELEPORT FOLLOW ==========
local function isPlayerAliveForTP(plr)
    if not plr.Character then return false end
    local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum and hum.Health > 0
end

local function getNearestEnemyHead()
    local closestDistance = math.huge
    local closestHead = nil
    local closestPlr = nil
    local myPos = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and lp.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    
    if not myPos then return nil, nil end
    
    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= lp and isPlayerAliveForTP(plr) and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            local head = plr.Character.Head
            local distance = (myPos - head.Position).Magnitude
            if distance < closestDistance then
                closestDistance = distance
                closestHead = head
                closestPlr = plr
            end
        end
    end
    return closestHead, closestPlr
end

local function cleanupBodyPosition()
    if bodyPosition then
        bodyPosition:Destroy()
        bodyPosition = nil
    end
end

local function stopFollow()
    followActive = false
    
    if followConnection then
        followConnection:Disconnect()
        followConnection = nil
    end
    
    cleanupBodyPosition()
    
    if lp.Character then
        local hum = lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.AutoRotate = true
            hum.PlatformStand = false
        end
        for _, part in pairs(lp.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = true
            end
        end
    end
    
    if followBtn then
        followBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 30, 50)
        followBtn.Text = "👣 TELEPORT FOLLOW"
    end
end

local function startFollow()
    if followActive then
        stopFollow()
        return
    end
    
    local targetHead, targetPlr = getNearestEnemyHead()
    if not targetHead then
        local notif = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        notif.Parent = screenGui
        notif.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 40)
        notif.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -20)
        notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
        notif.Text = "❌ AUCUN ENNEMI !"
        notif.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        notif.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        notif.TextScaled = true
        local notifCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", notif)
        notifCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        task.wait(1.5)
        notif:Destroy()
        return
    end
    
    followActive = true
    followTarget = targetPlr
    
    if lp.Character then
        for _, part in pairs(lp.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
    
    followConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not followActive then return end
        
        local currentTarget = nil
        local currentPlr = followTarget
        
        if currentPlr and currentPlr.Character and currentPlr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and isPlayerAliveForTP(currentPlr) then
            currentTarget = currentPlr.Character.Head
        else
            local newHead, newPlr = getNearestEnemyHead()
            if newHead then
                currentTarget = newHead
                currentPlr = newPlr
                followTarget = newPlr
            else
                stopFollow()
                return
            end
        end
        
        if currentTarget and lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = lp.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local targetPos = currentTarget.Position + Vector3.new(0, SETTINGS.FOLLOW_HEIGHT, 0)
            
            local camPos = cam.CFrame
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos)
            cam.CFrame = camPos
            
            local hum = lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.AutoRotate = false
                hum.PlatformStand = true
            end
        end
    end)
    
    followBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50)
    followBtn.Text = "🔴 FOLLOW ACTIF"
end

-- ========== FONCTIONS DARK TEXTURE ==========
local darkTextureActive = false
local darkTextureConnection = nil

local function isMapPart(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    if part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then return false end
    local parentModel = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    if parentModel and parentModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return false end
    if part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh") or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart") then return false end
    if part.Size.Magnitude < 5 then return false end
    if part.Material == Enum.Material.Grass or (part.Name:lower():find("tree")) then return false end
    if not part.Anchored then return false end
    return true
end

local function applyDarkTexture()
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if isMapPart(part) then
            part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
            part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        end
    end
end

local function startDarkTexture()
    if darkTextureConnection then darkTextureConnection:Disconnect() end
    darkTextureActive = true
    applyDarkTexture()
    darkTextureConnection = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
        if darkTextureActive and isMapPart(desc) then
            task.wait(0.1)
            desc.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
            desc.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        end
    end)
end

local function stopDarkTexture()
    darkTextureActive = false
    if darkTextureConnection then
        darkTextureConnection:Disconnect()
        darkTextureConnection = nil
    end
end

-- ========== FONCTIONS UNLOCK ALL ==========
local function executeUnlockAll()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QP-Offcial/Roblox/refs/heads/main/UnlockAll.lua"))()
end

-- ========== SILENT AIM ==========
local function isPlayerAliveSA(plr)
    if not plr.Character then return false end
    local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum and hum.Health > 0
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if not SETTINGS.ENABLE_SILENT_AIM then return nil end
    
    local center = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local bestTarget = nil
    local bestDist = SETTINGS.FOV / 2
    
    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= lp and isPlayerAliveSA(plr) and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            local head = plr.Character.Head
            local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {lp.Character}
                local ray = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, (head.Position - cam.CFrame.Position), raycastParams)
                local visible = not ray or ray.Instance:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character)
                
                if visible then
                    local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if dist <= bestDist then
                        bestDist = dist
                        bestTarget = plr
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return bestTarget
end

-- Hook pour Silent Aim
local function setupSilentAim()
    local utilityModule = nil
    for _, module in pairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
        if module:IsA("ModuleScript") and module.Name == "Utility" then
            utilityModule = module
            break
        end
    end
    
    if utilityModule then
        local success, utility = pcall(function() return require(utilityModule) end)
        if success and utility and utility.Raycast then
            originalRaycast = utility.Raycast
            utility.Raycast = function(...)
                local args = {...}
                if SETTINGS.ENABLE_SILENT_AIM then
                    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
                    if closest and closest.Character and closest.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                        if #args >= 4 and args[4] == 999 then
                            args[3] = closest.Character.Head.Position
                        end
                    end
                end
                return originalRaycast(table.unpack(args))
            end
        end
    end
end

task.spawn(setupSilentAim)

-- ========== BOUTONS ==========
local function createButton(text, setting, icon)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Parent = scrollFrame
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = SETTINGS[setting] and Color3.fromRGB(100, 40, 180) or Color3.fromRGB(35, 30, 50)
    btn.Text = icon .. " " .. text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 14
    
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    
    local function toggle()
        SETTINGS[setting] = not SETTINGS[setting]
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = SETTINGS[setting] and Color3.fromRGB(100, 40, 180) or Color3.fromRGB(35, 30, 50)
        
        if setting == "ENABLE_LOCK" then
            updateCircleVisibility()
        elseif setting == "ENABLE_SILENT_AIM" then
            updateCircleVisibility()
        elseif setting == "ENABLE_FLY" then
            if SETTINGS.ENABLE_FLY then startFly() else stopFly() end
        elseif setting == "ENABLE_NOCLIP" then
            if SETTINGS.ENABLE_NOCLIP then startNoclip() else stopNoclip() end
        elseif setting == "ENABLE_ESP" or setting == "ENABLE_XRAY" then
            refreshESP()
        elseif setting == "ENABLE_DARK_TEXTURE" then
            if SETTINGS.ENABLE_DARK_TEXTURE then startDarkTexture() else stopDarkTexture() end
        elseif setting == "ENABLE_UNLOCK_ALL" then
            if SETTINGS.ENABLE_UNLOCK_ALL then executeUnlockAll() end
        end
    end
    
    setupButton(btn, toggle)
    return btn
end

-- ========== SLIDER ==========
local function createSlider(text, min, max, setting, icon)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Parent = scrollFrame
    container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 65)
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Parent = container
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
    label.Text = icon .. " " .. text .. ": " .. tostring(SETTINGS[setting])
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 210, 255)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextSize = 13
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    
    local sliderBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    sliderBg.Parent = container
    sliderBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
    sliderBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 28)
    sliderBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 30, 50)
    
    local bgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", sliderBg)
    bgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Parent = sliderBg
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 60, 220)
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    
    local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", fill)
    fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    
    local initialVal = (SETTINGS[setting] - min) / (max - min)
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(initialVal, 0, 1, 0)
    
    local dragging = false
    
    local function updateValue(inputPos)
        local sliderPos = sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X
        local sliderWidth = sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X
        if sliderWidth <= 0 then return end
        
        local pos = math.clamp((inputPos - sliderPos) / sliderWidth, 0, 1)
        local val = math.floor(min + (max - min) * pos)
        
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        label.Text = icon .. " " .. text .. ": " .. val
        SETTINGS[setting] = val
        
        if setting == "FOV" then
            updateCircleSize()
        elseif setting == "FLY_SPEED" then
            flySpeed = val
            if flyEnabled and bodyVelocity then
                local char = lp.Character
                if char then
                    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                        bodyVelocity.Velocity = hum.MoveDirection * val
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            updateValue(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging then
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                updateValue(input.Position.X)
            end
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    
    return container
end

-- ========== FPS BOOST ==========
local function optimizeFPS()
    pcall(function()
        for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("Texture") then v:Destroy() end
            if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("Fire") or v:IsA("Smoke") or v:IsA("Sparkles") then v:Destroy() end
            if v:IsA("PointLight") or v:IsA("SpotLight") or v:IsA("SurfaceLight") then v:Destroy() end
            if v:IsA("BloomEffect") or v:IsA("BlurEffect") or v:IsA("SunRaysEffect") then v:Destroy() end
            if v:IsA("Water") then v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic end
        end
        
        local sky = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
        if sky then sky:Destroy() end
        
        Lighting.ClockTime = 12
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        Lighting.Brightness = 1
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
    end)
end

local fpsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
fpsBtn.Parent = scrollFrame
fpsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
fpsBtn.Text = "⚡ FPS BOOST EXTREME"
fpsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 80, 50)
fpsBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
fpsBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
fpsBtn.TextSize = 14
local fpsCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", fpsBtn)
fpsCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
setupButton(fpsBtn, optimizeFPS)

        if conn then conn:Disconnect() end

    for _, line in pairs(tracerLines) do
        if line then line:Remove() end
    end
end)

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if SETTINGS.ENABLE_INFJUMP and lp.Character and not SETTINGS.ENABLE_FLY then
        local hum = lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end)

-- ========== ESP ==========
local function createTracer(plr)
    local line = Drawing.new("Line")
    line.Visible = false
    line.Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 60, 220)
    line.Thickness = 2
    line.Transparency = 0.7
    return line
end

local function cleanESP(plr)
    if espFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name) then
        espFolder[plr.Name]:Destroy()
    end
    if highlights[plr] then
        highlights[plr]:Destroy()
        highlights[plr] = nil
    end
    if tracerLines[plr] then
        tracerLines[plr]:Remove()
        tracerLines[plr] = nil
    end
    if espConnections[plr] then
        espConnections[plr]:Disconnect()
        espConnections[plr] = nil
    end
end

local function applyESP(plr)
    if plr == lp then return end
    
    cleanESP(plr)
    
    local function setupESP(character)
        if not character then return end
        local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        
        local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bg.Name = plr.Name
        bg.Parent = espFolder
        bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bg.Size = UDim2.new(5, 0, 2.5, 0)
        bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        bg.ResetOnSpawn = false
        
        local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
        nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.4, 0)
        nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLabel.Text = plr.Name
        nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        nameLabel.TextScaled = true
        
        local healthBarBg = Instance.new("Frame", bg)
        healthBarBg.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.15, 0)
        healthBarBg.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.45, 0)
        healthBarBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 45, 70)
        
        local healthBar = Instance.new("Frame", healthBarBg)
        healthBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        healthBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 60, 220)
        
        local tracer = createTracer(plr)
        tracerLines[plr] = tracer
        
        local renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not plr.Character or not plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                bg.Enabled = false
                if tracer then tracer.Visible = false end
                return
            end
            
            local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local healthPercent = hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth
                healthBar.Size = UDim2.new(healthPercent, 0, 1, 0)
                bg.Enabled = true
                bg.Adornee = hrp
                
                if healthPercent > 0.6 then
                    healthBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                elseif healthPercent > 0.3 then
                    healthBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0)
                else
                    healthBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                end
            else
                bg.Enabled = false
            end
            
            if SETTINGS.ENABLE_TRACERS and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local head = plr.Character.Head
                    local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                    if onScreen and tracer then
                        tracer.From = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y)
                        tracer.To = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                        tracer.Visible = true
                    else
                        tracer.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    tracer.Visible = false
                end
            elseif tracer then
                tracer.Visible = false
            end
        end)
        
        espConnections[plr] = renderConn
        
        if SETTINGS.ENABLE_XRAY then
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(140, 60, 220)
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.6
            hl.Adornee = character
            hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            hl.Parent = character
            highlights[plr] = hl
        end
    end
    
    if plr.Character then
        setupESP(plr.Character)
    end
    
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.5)
        setupESP(character)
    end)
end

local function refreshESP()
    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= lp then
            cleanESP(plr)
            applyESP(plr)
        end
    end
end

for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    task.spawn(function() applyESP(plr) end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(applyESP)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    cleanESP(plr)
end)

-- ========== AIM SNAP ==========
local function isPlayerAlive(plr)
    if not plr.Character then return false end
    local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum and hum.Health > 0
end

local function getTargetInFOV()
    local center = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local bestTarget = nil
    local bestDist = SETTINGS.FOV / 2
    
    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= lp and isPlayerAlive(plr) and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            local head = plr.Character.Head
            local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
                raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
                raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {lp.Character}
                local ray = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, (head.Position - cam.CFrame.Position), raycastParams)
                local visible = not ray or ray.Instance:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character)
                
                if visible then
                    local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if dist <= bestDist then
                        bestDist = dist
                        bestTarget = head
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return bestTarget
end

RunService:BindToRenderStep("NoksVIP_AimSnap", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
    if not SETTINGS.ENABLE_LOCK then return end
    if followActive then return end
    
    local char = lp.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local target = getTargetInFOV()
    
    if target then
        local currentPos = cam.CFrame.Position
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos, target.Position)
    end
end)
